_doc: The Concord's hull texture designs (mockup 24), baked: not used by the game. Each unwrapped and baked onto its own UVs by tools/blender/painted_bake.py --ship (never edited by hand): the UV mesh in ship space (+x port, +y up, +z bow, metres) and its painted colour, AO and glow maps. uv_m is metres of hull per UV unit.
